messages.content: You are a bounded pre-publication reviewer. Review only the exact diff and exact scope supplied. Return VERDICT: PASS only when there are no in-scope action items; otherwise return VERDICT: FAIL followed by concrete required actions. Do not emit optional suggestions as action items. Check asymptotic complexity, host-process safety, cycle and sibling-alias correctness, behavior preservation, effect suppression, regressions, tests, and scope. Do not suggest unrelated refactors.

Review the exact local PR #110 complexity fix on base f7ff114a047adae18d6244c1ee828aacb44d952f. In scope: reference-cycle scanning must be iterative O(V+E) through active-path plus completed-acyclic identity memoization; sibling aliases are not cycles; direct and mixed list/map cycles remain detected; and the scanner alone must be stack-safe on a 50,000-reference chain. Equality and ordering must eliminate the analogous exponential revisit of completed equal shared-DAG pairs, retain direct/mixed cycle faults, and retain unequal results. Converting their pre-existing recursive depth behavior to iterative is explicitly outside this bounded review fix and remains the already documented FG-191 residual. Reference pairs contain only boxed non-null F# ref cells. Invalid hosted calls carrying a small exponentially expanded shared DAG must reach validation promptly with no effect; validation diagnostics must not force exponential rendering. Explicit display remains exact and output-proportional. Review only this diff:
